units.zh: 斛律金 子光 羨
units.en: Hulü Jin; son Guang; Xian
units.literal: Hulü Jin; son Guang; Xian

units.zh: 斛律金，字阿六敦，朔州勑勒部人也。
units.en: Hulü Jin, styled Aluodun, was a native of the Chile tribe in Shuozhou.
units.literal: Hulü Jin, styled Aluodun, was a native of the Chile tribe in Shuozhou.

units.zh: 高祖倍侯利，以壯勇有名塞表，道武時率戶內附，賜爵孟都公。
units.en: His great-great-grandfather Beihouli, renowned beyond the frontier for strength and bravery, led his household to submit in the reign of Emperor Daowu of Wei and was granted the title duke of Mengdu.
units.literal: His great-great-grandfather Beihouli, renowned beyond the frontier for strength and bravery, led his household to submit in the reign of Emperor Daowu of Wei and was granted the title Duke of Mengdu.

units.zh: 祖幡地斤，殿中尚書。
units.en: His grandfather Fandijin served as director of the palace secretariat.
units.literal: His grandfather Fandijin served as Director of the Palace Secretariat.

units.zh: 父大那瓌，光祿大夫、第一領民酋長。
units.en: His father Dana'gui served as director of splendid honors and first chief of the submitted tribes.
units.literal: His father Dana'gui served as Director of Splendid Honors and First Chief of the Submitted Tribes.

units.zh: 天平中，金貴，贈司空公。
units.en: During Tianping, when Hulü Jin rose high, his father Dana'gui was posthumously made duke of works.
units.literal: During Tianping, when Jin rose high, Dana'gui was posthumously made Duke of Works.

units.zh: 金性敦直，善騎射，行兵用匈奴法，望塵識馬步多少，嗅地知軍度遠近。
units.en: Hulü Jin was honest and straightforward by nature, skilled at riding and archery; in campaigning he used Xiongnu methods — reading dust to know how many horse and foot were on the march, sniffing the ground to gauge an army's distance.
units.literal: Jin was honest and straightforward by nature, skilled at riding and archery; in campaigning he used Xiongnu methods — reading dust to know how many horse and foot were on the march, sniffing the ground to gauge an army's distance.

units.zh: 初為軍主，與懷朔鎮將楊鈞送茹茹主阿那瓌還北。
units.en: At first he served as a military commander; with the garrison general of Huaishuo, Yang Jun, he escorted the Ruru ruler Anagui back north.
units.literal: At first he served as a military commander; with the garrison general of Huaishuo, Yang Jun, he escorted the Ruru ruler Anagui back north.

units.zh: 瓌見金射獵，深嘆其工。
units.en: Anagui watched Hulü Jin hunting with bow and arrow and sighed deeply at his skill.
units.literal: Anagui watched Jin hunting with bow and arrow and sighed deeply at his skill.

units.zh: 後瓌入寇高陸，金拒擊破之。
units.en: Later Anagui raided Gaolu; Hulü Jin resisted and defeated him.
units.literal: Later Anagui raided Gaolu; Jin resisted and defeated him.

units.zh: 正光末，破六韓拔陵構逆，金擁衆屬焉，陵假金王號。
units.en: At the end of Zhenguang, Poliuhan Baling raised rebellion; Hulü Jin gathered troops and submitted to him, and Baling made Jin a nominal king.
units.literal: At the end of Zhenguang, Poliuhan Baling raised rebellion; Jin gathered troops and submitted to him, and Baling made Jin a nominal king.

units.zh: 金度陵終敗滅，乃統所部萬戶詣雲州請降，即授第二領民酋長。
units.en: Hulü Jin judged that Baling would ultimately be destroyed and annihilated; he then led the ten thousand households under his command to Yunzhou to surrender and was at once appointed second chief of the submitted tribes.
units.literal: Jin judged that Baling would ultimately be destroyed and annihilated; he then led the ten thousand households under his command to Yunzhou to surrender and was at once appointed Second Chief of the Submitted Tribes.

units.zh: 稍引南出黃瓜堆，為杜洛周所破，部衆分散，金與兄平二人脫身歸尒朱榮。
units.en: He gradually led his force south out of Huangguadui but was defeated by Du Luozhou; his troops scattered, and Hulü Jin and his elder brother Ping alone escaped to Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: He gradually led his force south out of Huangguadui but was defeated by Du Luozhou; his troops scattered, and Jin and his elder brother Ping alone escaped to Erzhu Rong.

units.zh: 榮表金為別將，累遷都督。
units.en: Erzhu Rong memorialized to have Hulü Jin made a separate commander; he rose in succession to grand commander.
units.literal: Rong memorialized to have Jin made a separate commander; he rose in succession to grand commander.

units.zh: 孝莊立，賜爵阜城縣男，加寧朔將軍、屯騎校尉。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhuang ascended the throne, Hulü Jin was granted the title baron of Fucheng County and additionally made general who pacifies the north and colonel of the towered cavalry.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhuang ascended the throne, Jin was granted the title Baron of Fucheng County and additionally made General Who Pacifies the North and Colonel of the Towered Cavalry.

units.zh: 從破葛榮、元顥，頻有戰功，加鎮南大將軍。
units.en: He followed in the defeats of Ge Rong and Yuan Hao, earned repeated battle merit, and was promoted to grand general who pacifies the south.
units.literal: He followed in the defeats of Ge Rong and Yuan Hao, earned repeated battle merit, and was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the South.

units.zh: 及尒朱兆等逆亂，高祖密懷匡復之計，金與婁昭、厙狄干等贊成大謀，仍從舉義。
units.en: When Erzhu Zhao and others rose in rebellion, Gao Huan secretly harbored a plan to restore the realm; Hulü Jin, together with Lou Zhao, Kudie Gan, and others, approved the great design and then followed in raising the righteous banner.
units.literal: When Erzhu Zhao and others rose in rebellion, the Grand Ancestor secretly harbored a plan to restore the realm; Jin, together with Lou Zhao, Kudie Gan, and others, approved the great design and then followed in raising the righteous banner.

units.zh: 高祖南攻鄴，留金守信都，領恒、雲、燕、朔、顯、蔚六州大都督，委以後事，別討李脩，破之，加右光祿大夫。
units.en: When Gao Huan attacked Ye from the south, he left Hulü Jin to hold Xindu, made him grand commander of the six provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, Shuo, Xian, and Yu, and entrusted him with rear affairs; separately Jin attacked Li Xiu and defeated him, and was promoted to right director of splendid honors.
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor attacked Ye from the south, he left Jin to hold Xindu, made him Grand Commander of the six provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, Shuo, Xian, and Yu, and entrusted him with rear affairs; separately Jin attacked Li Xiu and defeated him, and was promoted to Right Director of Splendid Honors.

units.zh: 會高祖於鄴，仍從平晉陽，追滅尒朱兆。
units.en: He joined Gao Huan at Ye and then followed in pacifying Jinyang and pursuing the destruction of Erzhu Zhao.
units.literal: He joined the Grand Ancestor at Ye and then followed in pacifying Jinyang and pursuing the destruction of Erzhu Zhao.

units.zh: 太昌初，以金為汾州刺史、當州大都督，進爵為侯。
units.en: At the beginning of Taichang, Hulü Jin was made governor of Fen Province and grand commander of that province, and his rank was advanced to marquis.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taichang, Jin was made Governor of Fen Province and Grand Commander of that province, and his rank was advanced to marquis.

units.zh: 從高祖破紇豆陵於河西。
units.en: He followed Gao Huan in defeating Hediouling west of the river.
units.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in defeating Hediouling west of the river.

units.zh: 天平初，遷鄴，使金領步騎三萬鎮風陵以備西寇，軍罷，還晉陽。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianping, he moved to Ye; Hulü Jin was ordered to lead thirty thousand foot and horse to garrison Fengling against Western raiders; when the campaign ended, he returned to Jinyang.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, he moved to Ye; Jin was ordered to lead thirty thousand foot and horse to garrison Fengling against Western raiders; when the campaign ended, he returned to Jinyang.

units.zh: 從高祖戰於沙苑，不利班師，因此東雍諸城復為西軍所據，遣金與尉景、厙狄干等討復之。
units.en: He followed Gao Huan in battle at Shayuan; the army withdrew without success, and for this the cities of eastern Yong were again seized by the Western army; Hulü Jin was dispatched with Wei Jing, Kudie Gan, and others to recover them.
units.literal: He followed the Grand Ancestor in battle at Shayuan; the army withdrew without success, and for this the cities of eastern Yong were again seized by the Western army; Jin was dispatched with Wei Jing, Kudie Gan, and others to recover them.

units.zh: 元象中，周文帝復大舉向河陽。
units.en: In the Yuanxiang era, Yuwen Tai again launched a great campaign toward Heyang.
units.literal: In the Yuanxiang era, the Zhou Emperor Wen again launched a great campaign toward Heyang.

units.zh: 高祖率衆討之，使金徑往太州，為掎角之勢。
units.en: Gao Huan led troops to attack him and sent Hulü Jin straight to Tai Province to form pincers.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor led troops to attack him and sent Jin straight to Tai Province to form pincers.

units.zh: 金到晉州，以軍退不行，仍與行臺薛脩義共圍喬山之寇。
units.en: When Hulü Jin reached Jin Province, because the army had withdrawn he did not advance; he then joined the mobile headquarters commander Xue Xiuyi in besieging the bandits at Qiaoshan.
units.literal: When Jin reached Jin Province, because the army had withdrawn he did not advance; he then joined the mobile headquarters commander Xue Xiuyi in besieging the bandits at Qiaoshan.

units.zh: 俄而高祖至，仍共討平之，因從高祖攻下南絳、邵郡等數城。
units.en: Before long Gao Huan arrived; together they pacified the enemy, and Hulü Jin then followed Gao Huan in capturing several cities including Southern Jiang and Shao Commandery.
units.literal: Before long the Grand Ancestor arrived; together they pacified the enemy, and Jin then followed the Grand Ancestor in capturing several cities including Southern Jiang and Shao Commandery.

units.zh: 武定初，北豫州刺史高仲密據城西叛，周文帝入寇洛陽。
units.en: At the beginning of Wuding, Gao Zhongmi, governor of Northern Yu Province, held the west of the city and rebelled, and Yuwen Tai invaded Luoyang.
units.literal: At the beginning of Wuding, Gao Zhongmi, Governor of Northern Yu Province, held the west of the city and rebelled, and the Zhou Emperor Wen invaded Luoyang.

units.zh: 高祖使金統劉豐、步大汗薩等步騎數萬守河陽城以拒之。
units.en: Gao Huan had Hulü Jin command Liu Feng, Bu Dahan Sa, and others with several tens of thousands of foot and horse to hold Heyang city against him.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor had Jin command Liu Feng, Bu Dahan Sa, and others with several tens of thousands of foot and horse to hold Heyang city against him.

units.zh: 高祖到，仍從破密。
units.en: When Gao Huan arrived, Hulü Jin again followed in defeating Zhongmi.
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor arrived, Jin again followed in defeating Zhongmi.

units.zh: 軍還，除大司馬，改封石城郡公，邑一千戶，轉第一領民酋長。
units.en: When the army returned, he was made grand marshal, his title was changed to duke of Shicheng Commandery with a fief of one thousand households, and he was transferred to first chief of the submitted tribes.
units.literal: When the army returned, he was made Grand Marshal, his title was changed to Duke of Shicheng Commandery with a fief of one thousand households, and he was transferred to First Chief of the Submitted Tribes.

units.zh: 三年，高祖出軍襲山胡，分為二道。
units.en: In the third year, Gao Huan led troops on a surprise attack against the Mountain Hu, dividing into two routes.
units.literal: In the third year, the Grand Ancestor led troops on a surprise attack against the Mountain Hu, dividing into two routes.

units.zh: 以金為南道軍司，由黃櫨嶺出。
units.en: Hulü Jin was made army supervisor of the southern route and went out by Huanglu Ridge.
units.literal: Jin was made army supervisor of the southern route and went out by Huanglu Ridge.

units.zh: 高祖自出北道，度赤谼嶺，會金於烏突戍，合擊破之。
units.en: Gao Huan himself went by the northern route, crossed Chihong Ridge, joined Hulü Jin at Wutu Fort, and together they attacked and defeated the enemy.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor himself went by the northern route, crossed Chihong Ridge, joined Jin at Wutu Fort, and together they attacked and defeated the enemy.

units.zh: 軍還，出為冀州刺史。
units.en: When the army returned, he went out as governor of Ji Province.
units.literal: When the army returned, he went out as Governor of Ji Province.

units.zh: 四年，詔金率衆從烏蘇道會高祖於晉州，仍從攻玉壁。
units.en: In the fourth year, an edict ordered Hulü Jin to lead troops by the Wusu route to join Gao Huan at Jin Province, and he then followed in the attack on Yubi.
units.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered Jin to lead troops by the Wusu route to join the Grand Ancestor at Jin Province, and he then followed in the attack on Yubi.

units.zh: 軍還，高祖使金總督大衆，從歸晉陽。
units.en: When the army returned, Gao Huan had Hulü Jin command the whole host on the return to Jinyang.
units.literal: When the army returned, the Grand Ancestor had Jin command the whole host on the return to Jinyang.

units.zh: 世宗嗣事，侯景據潁川降於西魏，詔遣金帥潘樂、薛孤延等固守河陽以備。
units.en: When Gao Cheng succeeded to affairs, Hou Jing held Yingchuan and surrendered to Western Wei; an edict dispatched Hulü Jin to command Pan Le, Xue Guyuan, and others to hold Heyang in defense.
units.literal: When Shizong succeeded to affairs, Hou Jing held Yingchuan and surrendered to Western Wei; an edict dispatched Jin to command Pan Le, Xue Guyuan, and others to hold Heyang in defense.

units.zh: 西魏使其大都督李景和、若干寶領馬步數萬，欲從新城赴援侯景。
units.en: Western Wei sent its grand commander Li Jinghe and Jogan Bao leading several tens of thousands of horse and foot, intending to go from Xincheng to relieve Hou Jing.
units.literal: Western Wei sent its Grand Commander Li Jinghe and Jogan Bao leading several tens of thousands of horse and foot, intending to go from Xincheng to relieve Hou Jing.

units.zh: 金率衆停廣武以要之，景和等聞而退走。
units.en: Hulü Jin led troops and halted at Guangwu to intercept them; Jinghe and the others, hearing of it, withdrew and fled.
units.literal: Jin led troops and halted at Guangwu to intercept them; Jinghe and the others, hearing of it, withdrew and fled.

units.zh: 還為肆州刺史，仍率所部於宜陽築楊志、百家、呼延三戍，置守備而還。
units.en: He returned as governor of Si Province and again led his division to build the three forts of Yangzhi, Baijia, and Huyan at Yiyang, posting garrisons before returning.
units.literal: He returned as Governor of Si Province and again led his division to build the three forts of Yangzhi, Baijia, and Huyan at Yiyang, posting garrisons before returning.

units.zh: 侯景之走南豫，西魏儀同三司王思政入據潁川。
units.en: When Hou Jing fled to Southern Yu, Western Wei commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators Wang Sizheng entered and seized Yingchuan.
units.literal: When Hou Jing fled to Southern Yu, Western Wei Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators Wang Sizheng entered and seized Yingchuan.

units.zh: 世宗遣高嶽、慕容紹宗、劉豐等率衆圍之。
units.en: Gao Cheng dispatched Gao Yue, Murong Shaozong, Liu Feng, and others to lead troops and besiege the city.
units.literal: Shizong dispatched Gao Yue, Murong Shaozong, Liu Feng, and others to lead troops and besiege the city.

units.zh: 復詔金督彭樂、可朱渾道元等出屯河陽，斷其奔救之路。
units.en: An edict again ordered Hulü Jin to supervise Peng Le, Kezhuhun Daoyuan, and others in going out to encamp at Heyang and cut off their route of rescue.
units.literal: An edict again ordered Jin to supervise Peng Le, Kezhuhun Daoyuan, and others in going out to encamp at Heyang and cut off their route of rescue.

units.zh: 又詔金率衆會攻潁川。
units.en: An edict again ordered Hulü Jin to lead troops to join the attack on Yingchuan.
units.literal: An edict again ordered Jin to lead troops to join the attack on Yingchuan.

units.zh: 事平，復使金率衆從崿阪送米宜陽。
units.en: When the affair was settled, Hulü Jin was again sent to lead troops from Eban to transport grain to Yiyang.
units.literal: When the affair was settled, Jin was again sent to lead troops from Eban to transport grain to Yiyang.

units.zh: 西魏九曲戍將馬紹隆據險要鬭，金破之。
units.en: The Western Wei commander of Jiuchu Fort, Ma Shaolong, held a strategic pass and fought; Hulü Jin defeated him.
units.literal: The Western Wei commander of Jiuchu Fort, Ma Shaolong, held a strategic pass and fought; Jin defeated him.

units.zh: 以功別封安平縣男。
units.en: For merit he was separately enfeoffed baron of Anping County.
units.literal: For merit he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Anping County.

units.zh: 顯祖受禪，封咸陽郡王，刺史如故。
units.en: When Gao Yang received the abdication, Hulü Jin was enfeoffed prince of Xianyang Commandery, remaining governor as before.
units.literal: When Xianzu received the abdication, Jin was enfeoffed Prince of Xianyang Commandery, remaining governor as before.

units.zh: 其年冬，朝晉陽宮。
units.en: That winter he attended court at the Jinyang palace.
units.literal: That winter he attended court at the Jinyang palace.

units.zh: 金病，帝幸其宅臨視，賜以醫藥，中使不絕。
units.en: Hulü Jin fell ill; the emperor visited his residence to look in on him, granted him medicine, and palace envoys came without cease.
units.literal: Jin fell ill; the emperor visited his residence to look in on him, granted him medicine, and palace envoys came without cease.

units.zh: 病愈還州。
units.en: When his illness healed, he returned to his province.
units.literal: When his illness healed, he returned to his province.

units.zh: 三年，就除太師。
units.en: In the third year, he was appointed grand preceptor at his post.
units.literal: In the third year, he was appointed Grand Preceptor at his post.

units.zh: 帝征奚賊，金從帝行。
units.en: The emperor campaigned against Xi bandits, and Hulü Jin followed the emperor on the march.
units.literal: The emperor campaigned against Xi bandits, and Jin followed the emperor on the march.

units.zh: 軍還，帝幸肆州，與金宴射而去。
units.en: When the army returned, the emperor visited Si Province, feasted and shot with Hulü Jin, and then departed.
units.literal: When the army returned, the emperor visited Si Province, feasted and shot with Jin, and then departed.

units.zh: 四年，解州，以太師還晉陽。
units.en: In the fourth year, he was relieved of his governorship and returned to Jinyang as grand preceptor.
units.literal: In the fourth year, he was relieved of his governorship and returned to Jinyang as Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 車駕復幸其第，六宮及諸王盡從，置酒作樂，極夜方罷。
units.en: The imperial carriage again visited his residence; the six palaces and all the princes followed; wine was set out and music performed, and only at the end of the night did the revel end.
units.literal: The imperial carriage again visited his residence; the six palaces and all the princes followed; wine was set out and music performed, and only at the end of the night did the revel end.

units.zh: 帝忻甚，詔金第二子豐樂為武衛大將軍，因謂金曰：「公元勳佐命，父子忠誠，朕當結以婚姻，永為蕃衛。」
units.en: The emperor was greatly pleased; he made Hulü Jin's second son Fengle general of martial guards and said to Jin, "Your Grace's founding merit aided the mandate; father and son are loyal — I shall bind us by marriage and make you a frontier shield forever."
units.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased; he made Jin's second son Fengle General of Martial Guards and said to Jin, "Your Grace's founding merit aided the mandate; father and son are loyal — I shall bind us by marriage and make you a frontier shield forever."

units.zh: 仍詔金孫武都尚義寧公主。
units.en: An edict then ordered Hulü Jin's grandson Wudu to marry Princess Yining.
units.literal: An edict then ordered Jin's grandson Wudu to marry Princess Yining.

units.zh: 成禮之日，帝從皇太后幸金宅，皇后、太子及諸王等皆從，其見親待如此。
units.en: On the day the rites were completed, the emperor followed the empress dowager in visiting Hulü Jin's residence; the empress, crown prince, and all the princes followed — such was the favor and intimacy shown him.
units.literal: On the day the rites were completed, the emperor followed the empress dowager in visiting Jin's residence; the empress, crown prince, and all the princes followed — such was the favor and intimacy shown him.

units.zh: 後以茹茹為突厥所破，種落分散，慮其犯塞，驚撓邊民，乃詔金率騎二萬屯白道以備之。
units.en: Later, because the Ruru were broken by the Turks and their clans scattered, fearing they would violate the frontier and alarm the border people, an edict ordered Hulü Jin to lead twenty thousand horsemen to encamp at Baidao in defense.
units.literal: Later, because the Ruru were broken by the Turks and their clans scattered, fearing they would violate the frontier and alarm the border people, an edict ordered Jin to lead twenty thousand horsemen to encamp at Baidao in defense.

units.zh: 而虜帥豆婆吐久備將三千餘戶密欲西過，候騎還告，金勒所部追擊，盡俘其衆。
units.en: The barbarian chieftain Doubatu Jiubei was secretly leading more than three thousand households westward; scouts returned and reported; Hulü Jin drove his division in pursuit and captured the whole host.
units.literal: The barbarian chieftain Doubatu Jiubei was secretly leading more than three thousand households westward; scouts returned and reported; Jin drove his division in pursuit and captured the whole host.

units.zh: 茹茹但缽將舉國西徙，金獲其候騎送之，並表陳虜可擊取之勢。
units.en: Ruru Danbo was about to move the whole nation west; Hulü Jin captured his scouts and sent them in, and also memorialized describing how the barbarians could be attacked and taken.
units.literal: Ruru Danbo was about to move the whole nation west; Jin captured his scouts and sent them in, and also memorialized describing how the barbarians could be attacked and taken.

units.zh: 顯祖於是率衆與金共討之於吐賴，獲二萬餘戶而還。
units.en: Gao Yang thereupon led troops and together with Hulü Jin attacked them at Tulai, capturing more than twenty thousand households before returning.
units.literal: Xianzu thereupon led troops and together with Jin attacked them at Tulai, capturing more than twenty thousand households before returning.

units.zh: 進位右丞相，食齊州幹，遷左丞相。
units.en: His rank was advanced to right chancellor, with income from Qi Province; he was transferred to left chancellor.
units.literal: His rank was advanced to Right Chancellor, with income from Qi Province; he was transferred to Left Chancellor.

units.zh: 肅宗踐阼，納其孫女為皇太子妃。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao ascended the throne, he took Jin's granddaughter as crown prince consort.
units.literal: When Suzong ascended the throne, he took Jin's granddaughter as crown prince consort.

units.zh: 又詔金朝見，聽步挽車至階。
units.en: Another edict summoned Jin to court and allowed him to ride a hand-drawn carriage all the way to the steps.
units.literal: Another edict summoned Jin to court and permitted him to have a hand-drawn carriage pulled up to the steps.

units.zh: 世祖登極，禮遇彌重，又納其孫女為太子妃。
units.en: When Emperor Wucheng came to the throne, the honors grew still greater, and another of Jin's granddaughters was taken as crown prince consort.
units.literal: When Shizu ascended the throne, the rites and treatment became even more weighty, and he again took Jin's granddaughter as crown prince consort.

units.zh: 金長子光大將軍，次子羨及孫武都並開府儀同三司，出鎮方岳，其餘子孫皆封侯貴達。
units.en: Jin's eldest son Guang was Grand General, while his second son Xian and his grandson Wudu both held Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies and served as regional commanders; the rest of his descendants were all enfeoffed as marquises and rose to high rank.
units.literal: Jin's eldest son Guang was Grand General; his second son Xian and his grandson Wudu both held Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies and went out to guard regional commands; the rest of his sons and grandsons were all enfeoffed as marquises and reached high rank.

units.zh: 一門一皇后、二太子妃、三公主，尊寵之盛，當時莫比。
units.en: One household had one empress, two crown prince consorts, and three princesses; the fullness of its honor and favor was unmatched at the time.
units.literal: One household had one empress, two crown prince consorts, and three princesses; the fullness of its honor and favor was unmatched at the time.

units.zh: 金嘗謂光曰：「我雖不讀書，聞古來外戚梁冀等無不傾滅。
units.en: Jin once said to Guang, "I may not read books, but I have heard that imperial in-laws from Liang Ji onward have all ended in ruin.
units.literal: Jin once said to Guang, "Though I do not read books, I have heard that from antiquity imperial in-laws such as Liang Ji have never failed to be overthrown and destroyed.

units.zh: 女若有寵，諸貴人妒；
units.en: If a daughter is favored, the great families grow jealous;
units.literal: If a daughter receives favor, the noble people will be jealous;

units.zh: 女若無寵，天子嫌之。
units.en: if she is not favored, the Son of Heaven resents her.
units.literal: if a daughter receives no favor, the Son of Heaven resents her.

units.zh: 我家直以立勳抱忠致富貴，豈可藉女也？」
units.en: Our house has grown rich and noble by merit and loyalty alone. How could we rely on daughters?"
units.literal: Our house has attained wealth and rank simply by establishing merit and holding loyalty; how can we rely on daughters?"

units.zh: 辭不獲免，常以為憂。
units.en: Unable to refuse the imperial matches, he always regarded them as a source of worry.
units.literal: He could not obtain exemption by refusing, and always took this as a worry.

units.zh: 天統三年薨，年八十。
units.en: He died in the third year of Tiantong, aged eighty.
units.literal: He died in the third year of Tiantong, aged eighty.

units.zh: 世祖舉哀西堂，後主又舉哀於晉陽宮。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng mourned him in the Western Hall, and the Later Lord held another mourning ceremony in Jinyang Palace.
units.literal: Shizu raised mourning in the Western Hall, and the Later Lord again raised mourning in Jinyang Palace.

units.zh: 贈假黃鉞、使持節、都督朔定冀並瀛青齊滄幽肆晉汾十二州諸軍事、相國、太尉公、錄尚書、朔州刺史，酋長、王如故，贈錢百萬，謚曰武。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe, bearer of the staff of authority, overall command of military affairs in the twelve provinces of Shuo, Ding, Ji, Bing, Ying, Qing, Qi, Cang, You, Si, Jin, and Fen, and the titles Chancellor of State, Duke Grand Commandant, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Inspector of Shuo Province. His offices as tribal chief and prince remained as before; he received one million cash, and his posthumous name was Wu.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the acting yellow battle-axe, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the twelve provinces of Shuo, Ding, Ji, Bing, Ying, Qing, Qi, Cang, You, Si, Jin, and Fen, Chancellor of State, Duke Grand Commandant, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Inspector of Shuo Province; his offices as tribal chief and prince remained as before; he was posthumously granted one million cash, and his posthumous name was Wu.

units.zh: 子光嗣。
units.en: His son Guang succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Guang succeeded him.

units.zh: 光，字明月，少工騎射，以武藝知名。
units.en: Guang, styled Mingyue, from youth was skilled at riding and archery and was renowned for martial prowess.
units.literal: Guang, styled Mingyue, from youth was skilled at riding and archery and was renowned for martial prowess.

units.zh: 魏末，從金西征，周文帝長史莫孝暉時在行間，光馳馬射中之，因擒於陣，光時年十七。
units.en: At the end of Wei, he followed Hulü Jin on the western campaign; Yuwen Tai's chief administrator Mo Xiaohui was then in the ranks; Hulü Guang galloped forward and shot him, then captured him on the field — Guang was then seventeen.
units.literal: At the end of Wei, he followed Jin on the western campaign; the Zhou Emperor Wen's chief administrator Mo Xiaohui was then in the ranks; Guang galloped forward and shot him, then captured him on the field — Guang was then seventeen.

units.zh: 高祖嘉之，即擢為都督。
units.en: Gao Huan praised this and at once promoted Hulü Guang to grand commander.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor praised this and at once promoted him to grand commander.

units.zh: 世宗為世子，引為親信都督，稍遷征虜將軍，累加衛將軍。
units.en: When Gao Cheng was heir apparent, Hulü Guang was brought in as a trusted commander; he was gradually promoted to general who represses barbarians and cumulatively advanced to general of the guard.
units.literal: When Shizong was heir apparent, he was brought in as a trusted commander; he was gradually promoted to General Who Represses Barbarians and cumulatively advanced to General of the Guard.

units.zh: 武定五年，封永樂縣子。
units.en: In the fifth year of Wuding, he was enfeoffed viscount of Yongle County.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Wuding, he was enfeoffed Viscount of Yongle County.

units.zh: 嘗從世宗於洹橋校獵，見一大鳥，雲表飛颺，光引弓射之，正中其頸。
units.en: Once he followed Gao Cheng in a hunt at Huan Bridge; he saw a great bird soaring above the clouds; Hulü Guang drew his bow and shot it, striking it square in the neck.
units.literal: Once he followed Shizong in a hunt at Huan Bridge; he saw a great bird soaring above the clouds; Guang drew his bow and shot it, striking it square in the neck.

units.zh: 此鳥形如車輪，旋轉而下，至地，乃大雕也。
units.en: The bird was the size of a wheel; it spun downward to earth — it was a great eagle.
units.literal: The bird was the size of a wheel; it spun downward to earth — it was a great eagle.

units.zh: 世宗取而觀之，深壯異焉。
units.en: Gao Cheng took it to look at it and was deeply struck by the marvel.
units.literal: Shizong took it to look at it and was deeply struck by the marvel.

units.zh: 丞相屬邢子高見而嘆曰：「此射雕手也。」
units.en: Xing Zichao, an aide in the chancellor's office, saw it and sighed, "This is an eagle-shooter."
units.literal: Xing Zichao, an aide in the chancellor's office, saw it and sighed, "This is an eagle-shooter."

units.zh: 當時傳號落雕都督。
units.en: At the time he was known by the sobriquet Commander Who Drops Eagles.
units.literal: At the time he was known by the sobriquet Commander Who Drops Eagles.

units.zh: 尋兼左衛將軍，進爵為伯。
units.en: Soon he also served as left general of the guard and his rank was advanced to baron.
units.literal: Soon he also served as Left General of the Guard and his rank was advanced to baron.

units.zh: 齊受禪，加開府儀同三司，別封西安縣子。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was granted commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators and separately enfeoffed viscount of Xi'an County.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was granted Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators and separately enfeoffed Viscount of Xi'an County.

units.zh: 天保三年，從征出塞，光先驅破敵，多斬首虜，並獲雜畜。
units.en: In the third year of Tianbao, he followed a campaign beyond the frontier; Hulü Guang went ahead as vanguard and broke the enemy, beheading many and taking captives, and also seizing mixed livestock.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianbao, he followed a campaign beyond the frontier; Guang went ahead as vanguard and broke the enemy, beheading many and taking captives, and also seizing mixed livestock.

units.zh: 還，除晉州刺史。
units.en: On returning, he was made governor of Jin Province.
units.literal: On returning, he was made Governor of Jin Province.

units.zh: 東有周天柱、新安、牛頭三戍，招引亡叛，屢為寇竊。
units.en: To the east were the three Zhou forts of Tianzhu, Xin'an, and Niutou, which recruited fugitives and repeatedly raided and plundered.
units.literal: To the east were the three Zhou forts of Tianzhu, Xin'an, and Niutou, which recruited fugitives and repeatedly raided and plundered.

units.zh: 七年，光率步騎五千襲破之，又大破周儀同王敬儁等，獲口五百餘人，雜畜千餘頭而還。
units.en: In the seventh year, Hulü Guang led five thousand foot and horse in a surprise attack and broke them; he also greatly defeated the Zhou commissioner Wang Jingjun and others, taking more than five hundred captives and more than a thousand head of mixed livestock before returning.
units.literal: In the seventh year, Guang led five thousand foot and horse in a surprise attack and broke them; he also greatly defeated the Zhou commissioner Wang Jingjun and others, taking more than five hundred captives and more than a thousand head of mixed livestock before returning.

units.zh: 九年，又率衆取周絳川、白馬、澮交、翼城等四戍。
units.en: In the ninth year, he again led troops and took the four Zhou forts of Jiangchuan, Baima, Huaijiao, and Yicheng.
units.literal: In the ninth year, he again led troops and took the four Zhou forts of Jiangchuan, Baima, Huaijiao, and Yicheng.

units.zh: 除朔州刺史。
units.en: He was made governor of Shuo Province.
units.literal: He was made Governor of Shuo Province.

units.zh: 十年，除特進、開府儀同三司。
units.en: In the tenth year, he was made special grand master and commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators.
units.literal: In the tenth year, he was made Special Grand Master and Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators.

units.zh: 二月，率騎一萬討周開府曹迴公，斬之。
units.en: In the second month, he led ten thousand horsemen to attack the Zhou opener of a government office Cao Huigong and beheaded him.
units.literal: In the second month, he led ten thousand horsemen to attack the Zhou opener of a government office Cao Huigong and beheaded him.

units.zh: 栢谷城主儀同薛禹生棄城奔遁，遂取文侯鎮，立戍置柵而還。
units.en: The commissioner of Baigu Fort, Xue Yusheng, abandoned the city and fled; Hulü Guang then took Wenhou Fort, established a garrison, set palisades, and returned.
units.literal: The commissioner of Baigu Fort, Xue Yusheng, abandoned the city and fled; Guang then took Wenhou Fort, established a garrison, set palisades, and returned.

units.zh: 乾明元年，除并州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Ganming, he was made governor of Bing Province.
units.literal: In the first year of Ganming, he was made Governor of Bing Province.

units.zh: 皇建元年，進爵鉅鹿郡公。
units.en: In the first year of Huangjian, his rank was advanced to duke of Julu Commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Huangjian, his rank was advanced to Duke of Julu Commandery.

units.zh: 時樂陵王百年為皇太子，肅宗以光世載醇謹，兼著勳王室，納其長女為太子妃。
units.en: At that time Bainian, Prince of Leling, was crown prince. Emperor Xiaozhao, because the Hulü family had been upright and cautious for generations and Hulü Guang had rendered distinguished service to the imperial house, took Guang's eldest daughter as the crown prince's consort.
units.literal: At that time Bainian, Prince of Leling, was crown prince; Suzong, because Guang's family had been upright and cautious for generations and Guang had also rendered distinguished service to the imperial house, took his eldest daughter as the crown prince's consort.

units.zh: 大寧元年，除尚書右僕射，食中山郡幹。
units.en: In the first year of Daning, he was made right vice director of the masters of writing, with income from Zhongshan Commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Daning, he was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, with income from Zhongshan Commandery.

units.zh: 二年，除太子太保。
units.en: In the second year, he was made grand tutor to the crown prince.
units.literal: In the second year, he was made Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 河清二年四月，光率步騎二萬築勳掌城於軹關西，仍築長城二百里，置十三戍。
units.en: In the fourth month of the second year of Heqing, Hulü Guang led twenty thousand foot and horse to build Xunzhang Fort west of Zhiguan Pass and also built two hundred li of the Great Wall, establishing thirteen garrisons.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Heqing, Guang led twenty thousand foot and horse to build Xunzhang Fort west of Zhiguan Pass and also built two hundred li of the Great Wall, establishing thirteen garrisons.

units.zh: 三年正月，周遣將達奚成興等來寇平陽，詔光率步騎三萬禦之，興等聞而退走。
units.en: In the first month of the third year, Zhou dispatched generals Daxi Chengxing and others to raid Pingyang; an edict ordered Hulü Guang to lead thirty thousand foot and horse against them; Chengxing and the others, hearing of it, withdrew and fled.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, Zhou dispatched generals Daxi Chengxing and others to raid Pingyang; an edict ordered Guang to lead thirty thousand foot and horse against them; Chengxing and the others, hearing of it, withdrew and fled.

units.zh: 光逐北，遂入其境，獲二千餘口而還。
units.en: Hulü Guang pursued north, entered their territory, and took more than two thousand captives before returning.
units.literal: Guang pursued north, entered their territory, and took more than two thousand captives before returning.

units.zh: 其年三月，遷司徒。
units.en: In the third month of that year, he was transferred to minister over the masses.
units.literal: In the third month of that year, he was transferred to Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 四月，率騎北討突厥，獲馬千餘匹。
units.en: In the fourth month, he led horsemen north to attack the Turks and took more than a thousand horses.
units.literal: In the fourth month, he led horsemen north to attack the Turks and took more than a thousand horses.

units.zh: 是年冬，周武帝遣其柱國大司馬尉遲迥、齊國公宇文憲，柱國庸國公可叱雄等，衆稱十萬，寇洛陽。
units.en: That winter, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou dispatched his pillar of state and grand marshal Yuchi Tong, Duke of Qi State Yuwen Xian, and pillar of state and duke of Yong State Kechi Xiong and others — their host was said to number one hundred thousand — to raid Luoyang.
units.literal: That winter, the Zhou Emperor Wu dispatched his pillar of state and Grand Marshal Yuchi Tong, Duke of Qi State Yuwen Xian, and Pillar of State and Duke of Yong State Kechi Xiong and others — their host was said to number one hundred thousand — to raid Luoyang.

units.zh: 光率騎五萬馳往赴擊，戰於邙山，迥等大敗。
units.en: Hulü Guang led fifty thousand horsemen in a forced march to meet and attack them; they fought at Mount Mang, and Tong and the others were utterly defeated.
units.literal: Guang led fifty thousand horsemen in a forced march to meet and attack them; they fought at Mount Mang, and Tong and the others were utterly defeated.

units.zh: 光親射雄，殺之，斬捕首虜三千餘級，迥、憲僅而獲免，盡收其甲兵輜重，仍以死者積為京觀。
units.en: Hulü Guang personally shot Kechi Xiong and killed him; more than three thousand heads and captives were cut down and taken; Yuchi Tong and Yuwen Xian barely escaped with their lives; all their armor, weapons, and baggage were seized, and the dead were heaped into a victory mound.
units.literal: Guang personally shot Xiong and killed him; more than three thousand heads and captives were cut down and taken; Tong and Xian barely escaped with their lives; all their armor, weapons, and baggage were seized, and the dead were heaped into a victory mound.

units.zh: 世祖幸洛陽，策勳班賞，遷太尉，又封冠軍縣公。
units.en: Gao Zhan visited Luoyang, assessed merit and distributed rewards, and transferred Hulü Guang to grand commandant; he was again enfeoffed duke of Champion County.
units.literal: Shizu visited Luoyang, assessed merit and distributed rewards, and transferred Guang to Grand Commandant; he was again enfeoffed Duke of Champion County.

units.zh: 先是世祖命納光第二女為太子妃，天統元年，拜為皇后。
units.en: Earlier Emperor Wucheng had ordered Guang's second daughter taken as crown princess; in the first year of Tiantong she was invested empress.
units.literal: Earlier the Shizu Emperor had ordered that Guang's second daughter be taken as crown princess; in the first year of Tiantong she was invested as empress.

units.zh: 其年，光轉大將軍。
units.en: That year Guang was made grand general.
units.literal: That year Guang was transferred to Grand General.

units.zh: 三年六月，父喪去官，其月，詔起光及其弟羨並復前任。
units.en: In the sixth month of the third year he left office upon his father's death; that same month an edict recalled Guang and his younger brother Xian to their former posts.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, on his father's death he left office; that same month an edict recalled Guang and his younger brother Xian to their former posts.

units.zh: 秋，除太保，襲爵咸陽王，並襲第一領民酋長，別封武德郡公，徙食趙州幹，遷太傅。
units.en: In autumn he was made grand preceptor, succeeded to the title prince of Xianyang and to the office of first chief of the tribal register, was separately enfeoffed duke of Wude Commandery with revenue transferred to Zhao Province, and was promoted to grand tutor.
units.literal: In autumn he was made Grand Preceptor, succeeded to the title Prince of Xianyang, and also succeeded as First Chief of the Tribal Register; separately he was enfeoffed Duke of Wude Commandery, his revenue was transferred to Zhao Province, and he was promoted to Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 十二月，周遣將圍洛陽，壅絕糧道。
units.en: In the twelfth month Zhou sent generals to besiege Luoyang and choke off its grain routes.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Zhou sent generals to besiege Luoyang and cut off its grain routes.

units.zh: 武平元年正月，詔光率步騎三萬討之。
units.en: In the first month of the first year of Wuping an edict ordered Guang to lead thirty thousand infantry and cavalry against them.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Wuping an edict ordered Guang to lead thirty thousand infantry and cavalry against them.

units.zh: 軍次定隴，周將張掖公宇文桀、中州刺史梁士彥、開府司水大夫梁景興等又屯鹿盧交道，光擐甲執銳，身先士卒，鋒刃才交，桀衆大潰，斬首二千餘級。
units.en: The army halted at Dinglong. Zhou generals Zhangye Duke Yuwen Jie, Zhong Province governor Liang Shiyan, and Kaifu director of water affairs Liang Jingxing and others had again encamped at the Lulu crossroads. Guang donned armor, seized a sharp blade, and led from the front; blades had barely crossed when Jie's men broke completely — more than two thousand heads were taken.
units.literal: The army halted at Dinglong; Zhou generals Zhangye Duke Yuwen Jie, Governor of Zhong Province Liang Shiyan, and Kaifu Director of Water Affairs Liang Jingxing and others again encamped at the Lulu crossroads. Guang donned armor and took up sharp weapons, leading from the front; blades had barely crossed when Jie's force broke completely — more than two thousand heads were taken.

units.zh: 直到宜陽，與周齊國公宇文憲、申國公拓跋顯敬相對十旬。
units.en: He pressed straight to Yiyang and faced Zhou Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian and Duke of Shen Tuoba Xianjing in stalemate for a hundred days.
units.literal: He pressed straight to Yiyang and faced Zhou Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian and Duke of Shen Tuoba Xianjing in stalemate for a hundred days.

units.zh: 光置築統關、豐化二城，以通宜陽之路。
units.en: Guang built and garrisoned the fortresses Tongguan and Fenghua to keep the road to Yiyang open.
units.literal: Guang built and garrisoned the two fortresses Tongguan and Fenghua to open the road to Yiyang.

units.zh: 軍還，行次安鄴，憲等衆號五萬，仍躡軍後，光縱騎擊之，憲衆大潰，虜其開府宇文英、都督越勤世良、韓延等，又斬首三百餘級。
units.en: On the return march, when the army reached Anye, Xian's force — fifty thousand strong — still trailed behind. Guang unleashed cavalry and Xian's men broke completely. He captured their Kaifu Yuwen Ying, supervisor Yueqin Shiliang, Han Yan, and others, and took more than three hundred heads besides.
units.literal: On the return march, when the army reached Anye, Xian and the others numbered fifty thousand men and still trailed behind; Guang unleashed cavalry against them and Xian's force broke completely. He captured their Kaifu Yuwen Ying, Supervisor Yueqin Shiliang, Han Yan, and others, and took more than three hundred heads besides.

units.zh: 憲仍令桀及其大將軍中部公梁洛都與景興、士彥等步騎三萬於鹿盧交塞斷要路。
units.en: Xian then ordered Jie and his grand general Central Duke Liang Luodu, together with Jingxing, Shiyan, and others, to post thirty thousand infantry and cavalry at the Lulu pass and cut the vital route.
units.literal: Xian then ordered Jie and his grand general Central Duke Liang Luodu, together with Jingxing, Shiyan, and others, to post thirty thousand infantry and cavalry at the Lulu pass and block the vital route.

units.zh: 光與韓貴孫、呼延族、王顯等合擊，大破之，斬景興，獲馬千匹。
units.en: Guang joined Han Guisun, Huyan Zu, Wang Xian, and others in a combined attack and routed them completely, beheading Jingxing and taking a thousand horses.
units.literal: Guang joined Han Guisun, Huyan Zu, Wang Xian, and others in a combined attack and routed them completely, beheading Jingxing and taking a thousand horses.

units.zh: 詔加右丞相、并州刺史。
units.en: An edict additionally made him right chancellor and governor of Bing Province.
units.literal: An edict additionally made him Right Chancellor and Governor of Bing Province.

units.zh: 其冬，光又率步騎五萬於玉壁築華谷、龍門二城，與憲、顯敬等相持，憲等不敢動。
units.en: That winter Guang again led fifty thousand infantry and cavalry to build the fortresses Huagu and Longmen at Yubi and faced Xian, Xianjing, and the others in stalemate; Xian's men did not dare move.
units.literal: That winter Guang again led fifty thousand infantry and cavalry to build the two fortresses Huagu and Longmen at Yubi, facing Xian, Xianjing, and the others in stalemate; Xian and the rest did not dare move.

units.zh: 光乃進圍定陽，仍築南汾城。
units.en: Guang then pressed on to besiege Dingyang and also built the fortress Nanchen.
units.literal: Guang then pressed on to besiege Dingyang and also built the fortress Nanchen.

units.zh: 置州以逼之，夷夏萬餘戶並來內附。
units.en: A province was established to press them, and more than ten thousand households of barbarians and Chinese alike came over and submitted.
units.literal: A province was established to press them; more than ten thousand households of barbarians and Chinese alike came over and submitted.

units.zh: 二年，率衆築平隴、衛壁、統戎等鎮戍十有三所。
units.en: In the second year he led troops to build thirteen garrison fortresses, including Pinglong, Weiqi, and Tongrong.
units.literal: In the second year he led troops to build thirteen garrison fortresses, including Pinglong, Weiqi, and Tongrong.

units.zh: 周柱國枹罕公普屯威、柱國韋孝寬等步騎萬餘，來逼平隴，與光戰於汾水之北，光大破之，俘斬千計。
units.en: Zhou pillar lords Duke of Baohan Putun Wei and Wei Xiaokuan and others, with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry, came to press Pinglong. They fought Guang north of the Fen River; Guang routed them completely, capturing and slaying more than a thousand.
units.literal: Zhou pillar lord Duke of Baohan Putun Wei, pillar lord Wei Xiaokuan, and others with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry came to press Pinglong; they fought Guang north of the Fen River and Guang routed them completely, capturing and slaying more than a thousand.

units.zh: 又封中山郡公，增邑一千戶。
units.en: He was again enfeoffed duke of Zhongshan Commandery, with a fief increased by one thousand households.
units.literal: He was again enfeoffed Duke of Zhongshan Commandery, with a fief increased by one thousand households.

units.zh: 軍還，詔復令率步騎五萬出平陽道，攻姚襄、白亭城戍，皆克之，獲其城主儀同、大都督等九人，捕虜數千人。
units.en: When the army returned, an edict again ordered him to lead fifty thousand infantry and cavalry out by the Pingyang route against the garrison fortresses of Yaoqiang and Baiting; both fell. Nine fortress commanders of Yitong and grand governor rank were captured, along with several thousand prisoners.
units.literal: When the army returned, an edict again ordered him to lead fifty thousand infantry and cavalry out by the Pingyang route to attack the garrison fortresses of Yaoqiang and Baiting; both were taken. Nine fortress commanders of Yitong and grand governor rank were captured, and several thousand captives were taken.

units.zh: 又別封長樂郡公。
units.en: He was separately enfeoffed duke of Changle Commandery.
units.literal: He was separately enfeoffed Duke of Changle Commandery.

units.zh: 是月，周遣其柱國紇幹廣略圍宜陽。
units.en: That month Zhou sent its pillar lord Heggan Guanglue to besiege Yiyang.
units.literal: That month Zhou sent its pillar lord Heggan Guanglue to besiege Yiyang.

units.zh: 光率步騎五萬赴之，大戰於城下，乃取周建安等四戍，捕虜千餘人而還。
units.en: Guang led fifty thousand infantry and cavalry to the relief. A great battle was fought below the walls; he then took four Zhou garrisons including Jian'an and captured more than a thousand prisoners before returning.
units.literal: Guang led fifty thousand infantry and cavalry to the relief; a great battle was fought below the walls, and he then took four Zhou garrisons including Jian'an, capturing more than a thousand prisoners before returning.

units.zh: 軍未至鄴，敕令便放兵散。
units.en: Before the army reached Ye, an edict ordered the troops dismissed at once.
units.literal: Before the army reached Ye, an edict ordered the troops dismissed at once.

units.zh: 光以為軍人多有勳功，未得慰勞，若即便散，恩澤不施，乃密通表請使宣旨，軍仍且進。
units.en: Guang thought many soldiers had earned merit without yet receiving reward or comfort; if they were dismissed immediately, imperial favor would never reach them. He secretly sent a memorial asking that an envoy proclaim the edict while the army continued to advance.
units.literal: Guang thought that many soldiers had earned merit and had not yet been rewarded and comforted; if they were dismissed immediately, imperial favor would not reach them. He therefore secretly sent a memorial asking that an envoy be sent to proclaim the edict while the army continued to advance.

units.zh: 朝廷發使遲留，軍還，將至紫陌，光仍駐營待使。
units.en: The court's envoy was slow in coming. When the army returned and was nearing Zimo, Guang still encamped and waited for the envoy.
units.literal: The court's envoy was slow in coming; when the army returned and was nearing Zimo, Guang still encamped and waited for the envoy.

units.zh: 帝聞光軍營已逼，心甚惡之，急令舍人追光入見，然後宣勞散兵。
units.en: When the emperor heard that Guang's army camp was already pressing close, he was deeply displeased and urgently ordered a palace attendant to summon Guang for an audience; only then were the troops rewarded and dismissed.
units.literal: When the emperor heard that Guang's army camp was already pressing close, he was deeply displeased and urgently ordered a palace attendant to summon Guang for an audience; only then were the troops rewarded and dismissed.

units.zh: 拜光左丞相，又別封清河郡公。
units.en: Guang was made left chancellor and separately enfeoffed duke of Qinghe Commandery.
units.literal: Guang was made Left Chancellor and separately enfeoffed Duke of Qinghe Commandery.

units.zh: 光入，常在朝堂垂簾而坐。
units.en: When Guang entered court he would often sit behind the hanging curtain in the hall of audience.
units.literal: When Guang entered court he would often sit behind the hanging curtain in the hall of audience.

units.zh: 祖珽不知，乘馬過其前。
units.en: Zu Ting did not know and rode past in front of him.
units.literal: Zu Ting did not know and rode his horse past in front of him.

units.zh: 光怒，謂人曰：「此人乃敢爾！」
units.en: Guang was furious and said to others, "This man dares behave so!"
units.literal: Guang was angry and said to others, "This man dares behave so!"

units.zh: 後珽在內省，言聲高慢，光適過，聞之，又怒。
units.en: Later Ting was in the inner secretariat speaking in a loud, insolent voice. Guang happened to pass by, heard it, and grew angry again.
units.literal: Later Ting was in the inner secretariat speaking in a loud, insolent voice; Guang happened to pass by, heard it, and was angry again.

units.zh: 珽知光忿，而賂光從奴而問之曰：「相王瞋孝徵耶？」
units.en: Ting knew Guang's wrath and bribed one of Guang's attendants to ask, "Is the Prince angry with Xiaozheng?"
units.literal: Ting knew Guang's wrath and bribed one of Guang's attendants to ask, "Is the Prince angry with Xiaozheng?"

units.zh: 曰：「自公用事，相王每夜抱膝嘆曰：『盲人入，國必破矣！』」
units.en: The answer came: "Since you took power, the Prince every night sits hugging his knees and sighs, ‘The blind man has entered; the state is sure to fall!’"
units.literal: The answer came: "Since you took power, the Prince every night sits hugging his knees and sighs, ‘The blind man has entered; the state is sure to fall!’"

units.zh: 穆提婆求娶光庶女，不許。
units.en: Mu Tipo asked to marry Guang's concubine-born daughter; permission was refused.
units.literal: Mu Tipo asked to marry Guang's concubine-born daughter; permission was refused.

units.zh: 帝賜提婆晉陽之田，光言於朝曰：「此田神武帝以來常種禾，飼馬數千匹，以擬寇難，今賜提婆，無乃闕軍務也？」
units.en: The emperor bestowed on Tipo fields at Jinyang. Guang said at court, "These fields since the Shenwu Emperor have always been sown with grain to feed several thousand horses against enemy raids. To give them to Tipo now — will this not cripple military affairs?"
units.literal: The emperor bestowed on Tipo fields at Jinyang; Guang said at court, "These fields since the Shenwu Emperor have always been sown with grain to feed several thousand horses against enemy raids. To give them to Tipo now — will this not cripple military affairs?"

units.zh: 由是祖、穆積怨。
units.en: From this Zu and Mu nursed deep resentment.
units.literal: From this Zu and Mu nursed deep resentment.

units.zh: 周將軍韋孝寬忌光英勇，乃作謠言，令間諜漏其文於鄴，曰「百升飛上天，明月照長安」，又曰「高山不推自崩，槲樹不扶自豎」。
units.en: Zhou general Wei Xiaokuan, jealous of Guang's valor, composed slanderous verses and had spies leak the text at Ye: "A hundred pints fly up to heaven; Bright Moon shines on Chang'an," and also, "The high mountain needs no push to collapse; the oak needs no prop to stand straight."
units.literal: Zhou general Wei Xiaokuan, jealous of Guang's valor, composed slanderous verses and had spies leak the text at Ye: "A hundred pints fly up to heaven; Bright Moon shines on Chang'an," and also, "The high mountain needs no push to collapse; the oak needs no prop to stand straight."

units.zh: 祖珽因續之曰：「盲眼老公背上下大斧，饒舌老母不得語。」
units.en: Zu Ting then added to them: "The blind old husband carries a great axe on his back; the sharp-tongued old woman cannot speak."
units.literal: Zu Ting then added to them: "The blind old husband carries a great axe on his back; the sharp-tongued old woman cannot speak."

units.zh: 令小兒歌之於路。
units.en: He had children sing them in the streets.
units.literal: He had children sing them in the streets.

units.zh: 提婆聞之，以告其母令萱。
units.en: Tipo heard of it and told his mother Ling Xuan.
units.literal: Tipo heard of it and told his mother Ling Xuan.

units.zh: 萱以饒舌斥己也，盲老公謂珽也，遂相與協謀，以謠言啟帝曰：「斛律累世大將，明月聲震關西，豐樂威行突厥，女為皇后，男尚公主，謠言甚可畏也。」
units.en: Xuan took "sharp-tongued" as a reproach against herself and "blind old husband" as referring to Ting. They therefore joined in plotting and reported the verses to the emperor, saying, "The Hulü clan for generations has been great generals; Bright Moon's fame shakes the lands west of the passes, Fengle's authority reaches the Turks; a daughter is empress and sons marry princesses — the verses are truly fearsome."
units.literal: Xuan took "sharp-tongued" as a reproach against herself and "blind old husband" as referring to Ting; they therefore joined in plotting and reported the verses to the emperor, saying, "The Hulü clan for generations has been great generals; Bright Moon's fame shakes the lands west of the passes, Fengle's authority reaches the Turks; a daughter is empress and sons marry princesses — the verses are truly fearsome."

units.zh: 帝以問韓長鸞，鸞以為不可，事寢。
units.en: The emperor asked Han Changluan; Changluan said it could not be done, and the matter rested.
units.literal: The emperor asked Han Changluan; Changluan said it could not be done, and the matter rested.

units.zh: 祖珽又見帝請間，唯何洪珍在側。
units.en: Zu Ting again saw the emperor and asked for a private audience; only He Hongzhen was at his side.
units.literal: Zu Ting again saw the emperor and asked for a private audience; only He Hongzhen was at his side.

units.zh: 帝曰：「前得公啟，即欲施行，長鸞以為無此理。」
units.en: The emperor said, "I received your earlier memorial and at once wished to carry it out; Changluan said there was no reason for it."
units.literal: The emperor said, "I received your earlier memorial and at once wished to carry it out; Changluan said there was no reason for it."

units.zh: 珽未對，洪珍進曰：「若本無意則可，既有此意而不決行，萬一泄露如何？」
units.en: Before Ting could answer, Hongzhen stepped forward and said, "If there had never been such intent, that would be one thing; but once such intent exists and is not decisively carried out, what if it leaks?"
units.literal: Before Ting could answer, Hongzhen stepped forward and said, "If there had never been such intent, that would be one thing; but once such intent exists and is not decisively carried out, what if it leaks?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「洪珍言是也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Hongzhen speaks rightly."
units.literal: The emperor said, "Hongzhen speaks rightly."

units.zh: 猶豫未決。
units.en: He still hesitated, undecided.
units.literal: He still hesitated, undecided.

units.zh: 會丞相府佐封士讓密啟云：「光前西討還，敕令放兵散，光令軍逼帝京，將行不軌，事不果而止。
units.en: It happened that chief administrator of the chancellor's office Feng Shirang sent a secret memorial saying, "When Guang returned from the western campaign, an edict ordered the troops dismissed; Guang kept the army pressing the imperial capital, intending treason, but the plot failed and stopped.
units.literal: It happened that Chief Administrator of the Chancellor's Office Feng Shirang sent a secret memorial saying, "When Guang returned from the western campaign, an edict ordered the troops dismissed; Guang kept the army pressing the imperial capital, intending to commit treason, but the plot failed and stopped.

units.zh: 家藏弩甲，奴僮千數，每遣使豐樂、武都處，陰謀往來。
units.en: At home he hoards crossbows and armor and keeps a thousand-odd slaves and servants; he constantly sends messengers to Fengle and Wudu, plotting back and forth in secret.
units.literal: At home he hoards crossbows and armor; he has a thousand-odd slaves and servants; he constantly sends messengers to Fengle and Wudu, plotting back and forth in secret.

units.zh: 若不早圖，恐事不可測。」
units.en: If he is not dealt with early, I fear matters may become unpredictable."
units.literal: If he is not dealt with early, I fear matters may become unpredictable."

units.zh: 啟云「軍逼帝京」，會帝前所疑意，謂何洪珍云：「人心亦大聖，我前疑其欲反，果然。」
units.en: The memorial's words "the army pressing the imperial capital" matched the emperor's earlier suspicions. He said to He Hongzhen, "Heaven's mind is also a great sage — I earlier suspected he wished to rebel, and so it proves."
units.literal: The memorial's words "the army pressing the imperial capital" matched the emperor's earlier suspicions; he said to He Hongzhen, "Heaven's mind is also a great sage — I earlier suspected he wished to rebel, and so it proves."

units.zh: 帝性至怯懦，恐即變發，令洪珍馳召祖珽告之。
units.en: The emperor was by nature extremely timid. Fearing an immediate outbreak, he ordered Hongzhen to gallop and summon Zu Ting to tell him.
units.literal: The emperor was by nature extremely timid; fearing an immediate outbreak, he ordered Hongzhen to gallop and summon Zu Ting to tell him.

units.zh: 又恐追光不從命。
units.en: He also feared that if Guang were summoned he would not obey.
units.literal: He also feared that if Guang were summoned he would not obey.

units.zh: 珽因云：「正爾召之，恐疑不肯入。
units.en: Ting therefore said, "If you summon him directly, I fear he will suspect and refuse to enter.
units.literal: Ting therefore said, "If you summon him directly, I fear he will suspect and refuse to enter.

units.zh: 宜遣使賜其一駿馬，語云『明日將往東山遊觀，王可乘此馬同行』，光必來奉謝，因引入執之。」
units.en: You should send an envoy to bestow a fine horse on him, saying, 'Tomorrow I shall go to the Eastern Hills for an outing; the Prince may ride this horse and come with me' — Guang will surely come to give thanks, and you can then bring him in and seize him."
units.literal: You should send an envoy to bestow a fine horse on him, saying, 'Tomorrow I shall go to the Eastern Hills for an outing; the Prince may ride this horse and come with me' — Guang will surely come to give thanks, and you can then bring him in and seize him."

units.zh: 帝如其言。
units.en: The emperor did as he said.
units.literal: The emperor did as he said.

units.zh: 頃之，光至，引入涼風堂，劉桃枝自後拉而殺之，時年五十八。
units.en: Before long Guang arrived. He was brought into the Cool Breeze Hall, and Liu Taozhi strangled him from behind and killed him. He was fifty-eight.
units.literal: Before long Guang arrived; he was brought into the Cool Breeze Hall, and Liu Taozhi strangled him from behind and killed him. He was fifty-eight.

units.zh: 於是下詔稱光謀反，今已伏法，其餘家口並不須問。
units.en: Thereupon an edict was issued declaring that Guang had plotted rebellion and had now paid with his life; the rest of his household need not be investigated.
units.literal: Thereupon an edict was issued declaring that Guang had plotted rebellion and had now paid with his life; the rest of his household need not be investigated.

units.zh: 尋而發詔，盡滅其族。
units.en: Soon another edict was issued exterminating the entire clan.
units.literal: Soon another edict was issued exterminating the entire clan.

units.zh: 光性少言剛急，嚴於御下，治兵督衆，唯仗威刑。
units.en: Guang by nature spoke little, was stern and quick-tempered, and strict with subordinates; in drilling troops and supervising the ranks he relied solely on awe and punishment.
units.literal: Guang by nature spoke little, was stern and quick-tempered, strict in commanding subordinates; in drilling troops and supervising the ranks he relied solely on awe and punishment.

units.zh: 版築之役，鞭撻人士，頗稱其暴。
units.en: In corvée labor for wall-building he whipped gentlemen and was widely called brutal.
units.literal: In corvée labor for wall-building he whipped gentlemen and was widely called brutal.

units.zh: 自結發從戎，未嘗失律，深為鄰敵所懾憚。
units.en: From the time he first bound his hair and took up arms he never once lost discipline, and neighboring enemies deeply feared him.
units.literal: From the time he first bound his hair and took up arms he never once lost discipline; neighboring enemies deeply feared him.

units.zh: 罪既不彰，一旦屠滅，朝野痛惜之。
units.en: His guilt was never made clear, yet in a single day he was slaughtered to extinction; court and common people alike mourned and lamented.
units.literal: His guilt was never made clear, yet in a single day he was slaughtered to extinction; court and common people alike mourned and lamented.

units.zh: 周武帝聞光死，大喜，赦其境內。
units.en: When Emperor Wu of Zhou heard that Guang was dead he rejoiced greatly and proclaimed an amnesty within his borders.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou heard that Guang was dead he rejoiced greatly and proclaimed an amnesty within his borders.

units.zh: 後入鄴，追贈上柱國、崇國公。
units.en: Later, when he entered Ye, he posthumously enfeoffed Guang as pillar of state and duke of Chong.
units.literal: Later, when he entered Ye, he posthumously enfeoffed Guang as Pillar of State and Duke of Chong.

units.zh: 指詔書曰：「此人若在，朕豈能至鄴！」
units.en: Pointing at the edict he said, "If this man were still alive, how could I have reached Ye!"
units.literal: Pointing at the edict he said, "If this man were still alive, how could I have reached Ye!"

units.zh: 光有四子。
units.en: Guang had four sons.
units.literal: Guang had four sons.

units.zh: 長子武都，歷位特進、太子太保、開府儀同三司、梁兗二州刺史。
units.en: The eldest, Wudu, rose through the posts of special advance, grand preceptor to the crown prince, Kaifu Yitong Third Rank, and governor of Liang and Yan Provinces.
units.literal: The eldest, Wudu, rose through the posts of Special Advance, Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince, Kaifu Yitong Third Rank, and Governor of Liang and Yan Provinces.

units.zh: 所在並無政績，唯事聚斂，侵漁百姓。
units.en: Everywhere he served he showed no administrative achievement and devoted himself only to amassing wealth, plundering the common people.
units.literal: Everywhere he served he showed no administrative achievement and devoted himself only to amassing wealth, plundering the common people.

units.zh: 光死，遣使於州斬之。
units.en: When Guang died, an envoy was sent to the province to behead him.
units.literal: When Guang died, an envoy was sent to the province to behead him.

units.zh: 次須達，中護軍、開府儀同三司，先光卒。
units.en: Next was Xuda, central guard general and Kaifu Yitong Third Rank; he died before Guang.
units.literal: Next was Xuda, Central Guard General and Kaifu Yitong Third Rank; he died before Guang.

units.zh: 次世雄，開府儀同三司。
units.en: Next was Shixiong, Kaifu Yitong Third Rank.
units.literal: Next was Shixiong, Kaifu Yitong Third Rank.

units.zh: 次恒伽，假儀同三司。
units.en: Next was Hengga, acting Kaifu Yitong Third Rank.
units.literal: Next was Hengga, acting Kaifu Yitong Third Rank.

units.zh: 並賜死。
units.en: All were granted death.
units.literal: All were granted death.

units.zh: 光小子鐘，年數歲，獲免。
units.en: Guang's youngest son Zhong, only a few years old, was spared.
units.literal: Guang's youngest son Zhong, only a few years old, was spared.

units.zh: 周朝襲封崇國公。
units.en: Under the Zhou dynasty he inherited the enfeoffment as duke of Chong.
units.literal: Under the Zhou dynasty he inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of Chong.

units.zh: 隋開皇中卒於驃騎將軍。
units.en: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as general of fast cavalry.
units.literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as General of Fast Cavalry.

units.zh: 羨，字豐樂，少有機警，尤善射藝，高祖見而稱之。
units.en: Xian, styled Fengle, was quick-witted from youth and especially skilled in archery; Gao Huan saw him and praised him.
units.literal: Xian, styled Fengle, from youth was quick-witted and especially skilled in archery; the Grand Ancestor saw him and praised him.

units.zh: 世宗擢為開府參軍事。
units.en: Gao Cheng promoted him to staff officer of Kaifu.
units.literal: Shizong promoted him to staff officer of Kaifu.

units.zh: 遷征虜將軍、中散大夫，加安西將軍，進封大夏縣子，除通州刺史。
units.en: He was transferred to general who captures barbarians and palace attendant, additionally made general who pacifies the west, advanced in enfeoffment to viscount of Daxia County, and made governor of Tong Province.
units.literal: He was transferred to General Who Captures Barbarians and Palace Attendant, additionally made General Who Pacifies the West, advanced in enfeoffment to Viscount of Daxia County, and made Governor of Tong Province.

units.zh: 顯祖受禮，進號征西，別封顯親縣伯。
units.en: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, Xian's title was advanced to general who campaigns west and he was separately enfeoffed baron of Xianqin County.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, Xian's title was advanced to General Who Campaigns West and he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Xianqin County.

units.zh: 河清三年，轉使持節，都督幽、安、平、南、北營、東燕六州諸軍事，幽州刺史。
units.en: In the third year of Heqing he was transferred to bearer of the staff of authority and area commander of military affairs in the six provinces of You, An, Ping, South Camp, North Camp, and East Yan, and governor of You Province.
units.literal: In the third year of Heqing he was transferred to bearer of the staff of authority and Area Commander of military affairs in the six provinces of You, An, Ping, South Camp, North Camp, and East Yan, and Governor of You Province.

units.zh: 其年秋，突厥衆十餘萬來寇州境，羨總率諸將禦之。
units.en: That autumn more than a hundred thousand Turks came raiding the borders of the province; Xian took overall command of the generals to resist them.
units.literal: That autumn more than a hundred thousand Turks came raiding the borders of the province; Xian took overall command of the generals to resist them.

units.zh: 突厥望見軍威甚整，遂不敢戰，即遣使求款。
units.en: The Turks saw that the army's bearing was very orderly and did not dare fight; they at once sent envoys seeking terms.
units.literal: The Turks saw that the army's bearing was very orderly and did not dare fight; they at once sent envoys seeking terms.

units.zh: 慮其有詐，且喻之曰：「爾輩此行，本非朝貢，見機始變，未是宿心。
units.en: Fearing treachery, he also instructed them, saying, "Your journey this time was never a tribute mission; you changed only when you saw your chance — that is not a long-held intent.
units.literal: Fearing treachery, he also instructed them, saying, "Your journey this time was never a tribute mission; you changed only when you saw your chance — that is not a long-held intent.

units.zh: 若有實誠，宜速歸巢穴，別遣使來。」
units.en: If you have real sincerity, you should quickly return to your nests and send another envoy."
units.literal: If you have real sincerity, you should quickly return to your nests and send another envoy."

units.zh: 於是退走。
units.en: Thereupon they withdrew and fled.
units.literal: Thereupon they withdrew and fled.

units.zh: 天統元年夏五月，突厥木汗遣使請朝獻，羨始以聞，自是朝貢歲時不絕，羨有力焉。
units.en: In the fifth month of summer in the first year of Tiantong the Turk khan Muhan sent envoys requesting audience and tribute; Xian reported it for the first time. From then on tribute missions came every year without interruption — Xian had much to do with it.
units.literal: In the fifth month of summer in the first year of Tiantong the Turk khan Muhan sent envoys requesting audience and tribute; Xian reported it for the first time. From then on tribute missions came every year without interruption — Xian had much to do with it.

units.zh: 詔加行臺僕射。
units.en: An edict additionally made him vice director of the mobile office.
units.literal: An edict additionally made him Vice Director of the Mobile Office.

units.zh: 羨以北虜屢犯邊，須備不虞，自庫堆戍東拒於海，隨山屈曲二千餘里，其間二百里中凡有險要，或斬山築城，或斷谷起障，並置立戍邏五十餘所。
units.en: Because northern barbarians repeatedly violated the frontier and unexpected trouble had to be guarded against, from Kudui Garrison eastward to the sea he followed the mountains in a winding line of more than two thousand li. Within two hundred li of that stretch, wherever there was strategic ground, he either cut down mountains to build walls or blocked valleys to raise barriers, and in all established more than fifty garrison posts at intervals.
units.literal: Because northern barbarians repeatedly violated the frontier and unexpected trouble had to be guarded against, from Kudui Garrison eastward to the sea he followed the mountains in a winding line of more than two thousand li; within two hundred li of that stretch, wherever there was strategic ground, he either cut down mountains to build walls or blocked valleys to raise barriers, and in all established more than fifty garrison posts at intervals.

units.zh: 又導高梁水北合易京，東會於潞，因以灌田。
units.en: He also diverted the Gaoliang River northward to join Yijing and eastward to meet the Lu, and thereby irrigated fields.
units.literal: He also diverted the Gaoliang River northward to join Yijing, and eastward to meet the Lu, and thereby irrigated fields.

units.zh: 邊儲歲積，轉漕用省，公私獲利焉。
units.en: Frontier stores accumulated year by year, transport costs were saved, and both public and private interests profited.
units.literal: Frontier stores accumulated year by year; transport costs were saved, and both public and private interests profited.

units.zh: 其年六月，丁父憂去官，與兄光並被起復任，還鎮燕薊。
units.en: In the sixth month of that year, on his father's death he left office; he and his elder brother Guang were both recalled from mourning to their posts and returned to garrison Yan and Ji.
units.literal: In the sixth month of that year, on his father's death he left office; he and his elder brother Guang were both recalled from mourning to their posts and returned to garrison Yan and Ji.

units.zh: 三年，加位特進。
units.en: In the third year his rank was advanced to special advance.
units.literal: In the third year his rank was advanced to Special Advance.

units.zh: 四年，遷行臺尚書令，別封高城縣侯。
units.en: In the fourth year he was transferred to director of the masters of writing of the mobile office and separately enfeoffed marquis of Gaocheng County.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing of the Mobile Office and separately enfeoffed Marquis of Gaocheng County.

units.zh: 武平元年，加驃騎大將軍。
units.en: In the first year of Wuping he was additionally made general of fast cavalry.
units.literal: In the first year of Wuping he was additionally made General of Fast Cavalry.

units.zh: 時光子武都為兗州刺史。
units.en: At that time Guang's son Wudu was governor of Yan Province.
units.literal: At that time Guang's son Wudu was Governor of Yan Province.

units.zh: 羨歷事數帝，以謹直見推，雖極榮寵，不自矜尚，至是以合門貴盛，深以為憂。
units.en: Xian had served several emperors and was esteemed for his prudence and integrity; though he reached the utmost honor he did not pride himself on it — but now, with the whole house grown noble and powerful, he was deeply troubled.
units.literal: Xian had served several emperors and was esteemed for his prudence and integrity; though he reached the utmost honor he did not pride himself on it — but now, with the whole house grown noble and powerful, he was deeply troubled.

units.zh: 乃上書推讓，乞解所職，優詔不許。
units.en: He therefore submitted a memorial yielding his rank, begging to be released from his offices; a gracious edict did not permit it.
units.literal: He therefore submitted a memorial yielding his rank, begging to be released from his offices; a gracious edict did not permit it.

units.zh: 其年秋，進爵荊山郡王。
units.en: That autumn he was raised to Prince of Jingshan Commandery.
units.literal: That autumn, he was advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Jingshan Commandery.

units.zh: 三年七月，光誅，敕使中領軍賀拔伏恩等十餘人驛捕之。
units.en: In the seventh month of the third year, after Guang was put to death, an edict sent Central Palace Army Commander Helba Fu'en and a dozen others by relay horse to seize Xian.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, Guang was executed; an edict dispatched Central Palace Army Commander Helba Fu'en and more than ten others by post-horse relay to seize Xian.

units.zh: 遣領軍大將軍鮮于桃枝、洛州行臺僕射獨孤永業便發定州騎卒續進，仍以永業代羨。
units.en: Campaign commander Grand General Xianyu Taozhi and Luozhou circuit executive assistant Dugu Yongye were ordered to mobilize Ding Province cavalry at once as reinforcements, and Yongye was to replace Xian in office.
units.literal: Campaign Commander Grand General Xianyu Taozhi and Luozhou Circuit Executive Assistant Master of Writing Dugu Yongye were ordered to mobilize at once the cavalry of Ding Province as reinforcements; Yongye was to replace Xian.

units.zh: 伏恩等既至，門者白使人衷甲馬汗，宜閉城門。
units.en: When Fu'en and his men arrived, the gatekeepers reported that the envoys wore armor beneath their robes and their horses ran wet with sweat — the city gates ought to be barred.
units.literal: When Fu'en and the rest arrived, the gatekeepers reported that the envoys wore hidden armor and their horses were lathered with sweat — the city gates ought to be shut.

units.zh: 羨曰：「敕使豈可疑拒？」
units.en: Xian said, "How can one meet an imperial envoy with suspicion and turn him away?"
units.literal: Xian said: "How can an imperial envoy be met with suspicion and refusal?"

units.zh: 出見之，伏恩把手，遂執之，死於長史廳事。
units.en: He went out to receive them. Fu'en took his hand — and seized him. He died in the chief administrator's hall.
units.literal: He went out to receive them; Fu'en took him by the hand, seized him, and he died in the chief administrator's hall.

units.zh: 臨終嘆曰：「富貴如此，女為皇后，公主滿家，常使三百兵，何得不敗！」
units.en: At the end he sighed: "Wealth and honor such as this — a daughter made queen, princesses in every corner of the house, three hundred armed retainers always at call — how could we not fall?"
units.literal: At the end he sighed: "Wealth and honor such as this — a daughter queen, princesses filling the house, always keeping three hundred armed retainers — how could we not fall?"

units.zh: 及其五子世達、世遷、世辨、世酋、伏護，餘年十五已下者宥之。
units.en: His five sons Shida, Shiqian, Shibian, Shiyou, and Fuhu were put to death; those fifteen or younger were spared.
units.literal: And his five sons Shida, Shiqian, Shibian, Shiyou, and Fuhu were executed; those aged fifteen or under were spared.

units.zh: 羨未誅前，忽令其在州諸子自伏護以下五六人，鎖頸乘驢出城，合家皆泣送之至門，日晚而歸。
units.en: Before Xian was executed, he suddenly had five or six sons then in the province — from Fuhu on down — led out of the city with chains at their throats, riding donkeys. The whole household wept and escorted them to the gate, then returned as evening fell.
units.literal: Before Xian was executed, he suddenly had five or six of his sons then in the province — from Fuhu downward — led out of the city with chains around their necks, riding donkeys; the whole household wept and escorted them to the gate, then returned as evening fell.

units.zh: 吏民莫不驚異。
units.en: Officials and commoners alike were struck with wonder and dread.
units.literal: Officials and common people alike were startled and dismayed.

units.zh: 行燕郡守馬嗣明，醫術之士，為羨所欽愛，乃竊問之，答曰：「須有禳厭。」
units.en: Ma Siming, acting magistrate of Yan Commandery — a physician Xian held in esteem — privately asked what it meant. Xian answered, "We need a rite to turn aside ill fortune."
units.literal: Yan Commandery acting magistrate Ma Siming — a man skilled in medicine, whom Xian admired — privately asked him what it meant. Xian answered: "We need a rite to avert ill fortune."

units.zh: 數日而有此變。
units.en: Within days the calamity arrived.
units.literal: Within days this calamity came.

units.zh: 羨及光並少工騎射，其父每日令其出畋，還即較所獲禽獸。
units.en: Both Xian and Guang were skilled in riding and archery from youth. Each day their father sent them out to hunt; on their return he compared the game each had taken.
units.literal: Both Xian and Guang mastered riding and archery in youth; their father each day sent them out to hunt, and on their return compared what game each had taken.

units.zh: 光所獲或少，必麗龜達腋。
units.en: If Guang's bag was light, he always drove his arrow through the turtle's shell and out beneath the armpit.
units.literal: If Guang's bag was small, he always placed his arrow through the turtle's shell and clear through to the armpit.

units.zh: 羨雖獲多，非要害之所。
units.en: Xian might take more, but never in the vital places.
units.literal: Xian might take more, but not in the vital places.

units.zh: 光常蒙賞，羨或被捶撻。
units.en: Guang was often praised and rewarded; Xian was sometimes beaten with the rod.
units.literal: Guang was often rewarded; Xian was sometimes beaten with the rod.

units.zh: 人問其故，金答云：「明月必背上著箭，豐樂隨處即下手，其數雖多，去兄遠矣。」
units.en: When people asked why, Jin answered: "Mingyue always plants his arrow in the beast's back. Fengle strikes wherever he can — though the count may be greater, he falls far short of his elder brother."
units.literal: When people asked why, Jin answered: "Mingyue always plants his arrow in the beast's back; Fengle strikes wherever he can — though the count may be greater, he falls far short of his elder brother."

units.zh: 聞者咸服其言。
units.en: All who heard were convinced.
units.literal: All who heard were convinced by his words.

units.zh: 金兄平，便弓馬，有幹用。
units.en: Jin's elder brother Ping was skilled with bow and horse and had real capacity for command.
units.literal: Jin's elder brother Ping was skilled with bow and horse and possessed practical ability.

units.zh: 魏景明中，釋褐殿中將軍，遷襄威將軍。
units.en: In the Jingming era of Wei he entered service as a palace guard general and was transferred to Xiangwei General.
units.literal: During the Jingming era of Wei he entered service as a palace guard general and was transferred to Xiangwei General.

units.zh: 正光末，六鎮擾亂，隸大將軍尉賓北討。
units.en: At the end of Zhengguang, when the six garrisons fell into turmoil, he served under Grand General Yu Bin on the northern campaign.
units.literal: At the end of Zhengguang, when the six garrisons rose in turmoil, he served under Grand General Yu Bin on the northern campaign.

units.zh: 軍敗，為賊所虜。
units.en: The army was defeated and he was taken by the rebels.
units.literal: The army was defeated and he was captured by the rebels.

units.zh: 後走奔其弟金於雲州，進號龍驤將軍。
units.en: Later he fled to his brother Jin at Yunzhou and was advanced to Dragon-Tiger General.
units.literal: Later he fled to join his brother Jin at Yunzhou and was advanced to rank as Dragon-Tiger General.

units.zh: 與金擁衆南出，至黃瓜堆，為杜洛周所破，部落離散。
units.en: With Jin he led their following south. At Huangguadui they were broken by Du Luozhou and their tribes scattered.
units.literal: With Jin he led their following south; at Huangguadui they were routed by Du Luozhou and their tribes scattered.

units.zh: 及歸尒朱榮，待之甚厚，以平襲父爵第一領民酋長。
units.en: When they returned to Erzhu Rong, he was treated with great favor, and Ping inherited their father's title as First Chieftain of Registered Tribal Peoples.
units.literal: When they returned to Erzhu Rong, he was treated with great favor, and Ping inherited their father's title as First Chieftain of Registered Tribal Peoples.

units.zh: 高祖起義，以都督從。
units.en: When Gao Huan raised the righteous cause, Ping followed him as a commander.
units.literal: When Gaozu raised the righteous cause, Ping followed as a commander.

units.zh: 稍遷平北將軍、顯州刺史，加鎮南將軍，封固安縣伯。
units.en: He was gradually promoted to General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xian Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the South, and was enfeoffed as Baron of Gu'an County.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xian Province, additionally General Who Pacifies the South, and was enfeoffed as Baron of Gu'an County.

units.zh: 尋進為侯，行肆州刺史。
units.en: Soon he was advanced to marquis and acted as Inspector of Si Province.
units.literal: Soon he was advanced to marquis and acted as Inspector of Si Province.

units.zh: 周文帝遣其右將軍李小光據梁州，平以偏師討擒之。
units.en: Emperor Wen of Zhou sent his Right General Li Xiaoguang to occupy Liang Province; Ping campaigned with a detached force and captured him.
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Zhou sent his Right General Li Xiaoguang to occupy Liang Province; Ping campaigned with a detached force and captured him.

units.zh: 出為燕州刺史。
units.en: He went out as Inspector of Yan Province.
units.literal: He went out as Inspector of Yan Province.

units.zh: 入兼左衛將軍，領衆一萬討北徐賊，破之，除濟州刺史。
units.en: He entered court as acting Left Guard General, led ten thousand troops to attack the Northern Xu rebels, defeated them, and was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.
