units.literal: He entered court as acting Left Guard General, led ten thousand troops to attack the Northern Xu rebels, defeated them, and was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.

units.zh: 侯景度江，詔平為大都督，率青州刺史敬顯俊、左衛將軍厙狄伏連等略定壽陽、宿預三十餘城。
units.en: When Hou Jing crossed the Yangzi, Ping was appointed Grand Commander and led Inspector of Qing Province Jing Xianjun, Left Guard General Kudi Fulian, and others in securing more than thirty cities, including Shouyang and Suyu.
units.literal: When Hou Jing crossed the Yangzi, an edict made Ping Grand Commander; he led Inspector of Qing Province Jing Xianjun, Left Guard General Kudi Fulian, and others in taking and pacifying more than thirty cities including Shouyang and Suyu.

units.zh: 事罷還州，加開府，進位驃騎大將軍，進爵為公。
units.en: After the campaign ended he returned to his province, received Opening Office, was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry, and advanced in rank to duke.
units.literal: When the affair was over he returned to his province, was granted Opening Office, advanced to General of Agile Cavalry, and advanced in rank to duke.

units.zh: 顯祖受禪，別封羨陽侯。
units.en: When Xianzu received the abdication, Ping was separately enfeoffed as Marquis of Xianyang.
units.literal: When Xianzu received the abdication, Ping was separately enfeoffed as Marquis of Xianyang.

units.zh: 行兗州刺史，以黷貨除名。
units.en: While acting as Inspector of Yan Province, he was dismissed from office for corruption.
units.literal: Acting as Inspector of Yan Province, he was removed from the rolls for corruption.

units.zh: 後除開府儀同三司。
units.en: Later he was appointed Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: Later he was appointed Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 廢帝即位，拜特進，食滄州樂陵郡幹。
units.en: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne, Ping was appointed Specially Advanced and given income from Leling Commandery in Cang Province.
units.literal: When the Deposed Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Specially Advanced and received income from Leling Commandery in Cang Province.

units.zh: 皇建初，封定陽郡公，拜護軍。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Dingyang Commandery and appointed Protector of the Army.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Dingyang Commandery and appointed Protector of the Army.

units.zh: 後為青州刺史，卒。
units.en: Later he became Inspector of Qing Province and died.
units.literal: Later he became Inspector of Qing Province and died.

units.zh: 贈太尉。
units.en: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 史臣曰：斛律金以高祖撥亂之始，翼成王業，忠款之至，成此大功，故能終享遐年，位高百辟。
units.en: The historian writes: Hulü Jin, at the outset when Gao Huan was settling the chaos, helped establish the royal enterprise. His loyalty was complete, and so this great achievement was won — thus he lived out his years in full and stood above all the hundred ministers.
units.literal: The historian writes: Hulü Jin, at the outset when Gao Huan was settling the chaos, helped establish the royal enterprise; his loyalty was complete, and so this great achievement was won — thus he lived out his years in full and stood above all the hundred ministers.

units.zh: 觀其盈滿之戒，動之微也，才及後嗣，遂至誅夷，雖為威權之重，蓋符道家所忌。
units.en: Yet see how the warning against overflowing fullness moves in small ways: it had scarcely touched the next generation when execution and extermination followed. Though the weight of power was great, it still matched what the Daoist masters warn against.
units.literal: Yet see how the warning against overflowing fullness moves in small ways: it had scarcely touched the next generation when execution and extermination followed — though the weight of power was great, it still matched what the Daoist masters warn against.

units.zh: 光以上將之子，有沈毅之姿，戰術兵權，暗同韜略，臨敵制勝，變化無方。
units.en: Guang, as the son of a supreme general, bore a grave and resolute bearing. In tactical craft and military command he matched hidden stratagem — facing the enemy he seized victory, shifting without fixed form.
units.literal: Guang, as the son of a supreme general, bore a grave and resolute bearing; in tactical craft and military command he matched hidden stratagem — facing the enemy he seized victory, shifting without fixed form.

units.zh: 自關、河分隔，年將四紀。
units.en: Since the passes and the Yellow River divided the realm, nearly four decades had passed.
units.literal: Since the passes and the Yellow River divided the realm, nearly four decades had passed.

units.zh: 以高祖霸王之期，屬宇文草創之日，出軍薄伐，屢挫兵鋒。
units.en: At the height of Gao Huan's hegemony, in the very days when the Yuwen clan was first founding its state, their armies went forth on punitive raids and again and again blunted the enemy's edge.
units.literal: At the height of Gao Huan's hegemony, in the very days when the Yuwen clan was first founding its state, their armies went forth on punitive raids and again and again blunted the enemy's edge.

units.zh: 而大寧以還，東鄰浸弱，關西前收巴蜀，又殄江陵，叶建瓴而用武，成並吞之壯氣。
units.en: But from the Daning era onward, the eastern neighbor weakened by degrees. In the west they first took Bashu, then destroyed Jiangling — the tide ran downhill for war, and the spirit of annexation gathered strength.
units.literal: But from the Daning era onward, the eastern neighbor weakened by degrees; in the west they first took Bashu, then destroyed Jiangling — the tide ran downhill for war, and the spirit of annexation gathered strength.

units.zh: 斛律治軍誓衆，式遏邊鄙，戰則前無完陣，攻則罕有全城，齊氏必致拘原之師，秦人無復啟關之策。
units.en: The Hulü clan disciplined the army, rallied the host, and held the border fast — in battle no enemy line stood whole; in siege scarcely a city held intact. Qi could always bring the foe to bay; Qin no longer had a plan to force the passes open.
units.literal: The Hulü clan disciplined the army, rallied the host, and held the border fast — in battle no enemy line stood whole; in siege scarcely a city held intact. Qi could always bring the foe to bay; Qin no longer had a plan to force the passes open.

units.zh: 而世亂才勝，詐以震主之威；
units.en: Yet in an age of disorder, talent itself became a triumph — and fraud clothed itself in the majesty that overawes a ruler.
units.literal: Yet in an age of disorder, talent itself became a triumph — and fraud clothed itself in the majesty that overawes a ruler.

units.zh: 主暗時艱，自毀藩籬之固。
units.en: The ruler was dim, the times were hard, and the realm tore down its own ramparts.
units.literal: The ruler was dim, the times were hard, and the realm tore down its own ramparts.

units.zh: 昔李牧之為趙將也，北翦胡寇，西卻秦軍，郭開譖之，牧死趙滅。
units.en: Long ago, when Li Mu served Zhao as general, he cut down the northern raiders and drove back the armies of Qin. Guo Kai slandered him; Li Mu died, and Zhao was destroyed.
units.literal: Long ago, when Li Mu served Zhao as general, he cut down the northern raiders and drove back the armies of Qin — Guo Kai slandered him; Li Mu died, and Zhao was destroyed.

units.zh: 其議誅光者，豈秦之反間歟，何同術而同亡也！
units.en: Were those who counseled Guang's death perhaps Qin's agents of division? Same craft, same ruin!
units.literal: Were those who counseled Guang's death perhaps Qin's agents of division? Same craft, same ruin!

units.zh: 內令諸將解體，外為強鄰報讐。
units.en: Within, they had the generals disband; without, they repaid a powerful neighbor's grudge.
units.literal: Within, they had the generals disband; without, they repaid a powerful neighbor's grudge.

units.zh: 嗚呼！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 後之君子，可為深戒。
units.en: Men of later times — let this be a warning deeply taken.
units.literal: Men of later times — let this be a warning deeply taken.

units.zh: 贊曰：赳赳咸陽，邦家之光。
units.en: The encomium says: Steadfast Xianyang — brilliance of clan and state.
units.literal: The encomium says: Steadfast Xianyang — the brilliance of clan and state.

units.zh: 明月忠壯，仍世將相。
units.en: Mingyue, loyal and mighty — general and minister through generations.
units.literal: Mingyue, loyal and mighty — general and minister through generations.

units.zh: 聲振關右，勢高時望。
units.en: His fame shook the lands west of the passes; his stature outran the regard of his age.
units.literal: His fame shook the lands west of the passes; his stature outran the regard of his age.

units.zh: 迫此威名，易興讒謗。
units.en: Pressed by such renown, slander easily rose.
units.literal: Pressed by such renown, slander easily rose.

units.zh: 始自工言，終斯交喪。
units.en: It began with clever speech — and ended in mutual ruin.
units.literal: It began with clever speech — and ended in mutual ruin.

s0095.quote: 七年，光率步騎五千襲破之，又大破周儀同王敬儁等，獲口五百餘人，雜畜千餘頭而還。

s0099.quote: 二月，率騎一萬討周開府曹迴公，斬之。

s0100.quote: 栢谷城主儀同薛禹生棄城奔遁，遂取文侯鎮，立戍置柵而還。

s0103.quote: 時樂陵王百年為皇太子，肅宗以光世載醇謹，兼著勳王室，納其長女為太子妃。

s0107.quote: 三年正月，周遣將達奚成興等來寇平陽，詔光率步騎三萬禦之，興等聞而退走。

s0111.quote: 是年冬，周武帝遣其柱國大司馬尉遲迥、齊國公宇文憲，柱國庸國公可叱雄等，衆稱十萬，寇洛陽。

s0114.quote: 世祖幸洛陽，策勳班賞，遷太尉，又封冠軍縣公。

s0115.quote: 先是世祖命納光第二女為太子妃，天統元年，拜為皇后。

s0117.quote: 三年六月，父喪去官，其月，詔起光及其弟羨並復前任。

s0120.quote: 武平元年正月，詔光率步騎三萬討之。

s0121.quote: 軍次定隴，周將張掖公宇文桀、中州刺史梁士彥、開府司水大夫梁景興等又屯鹿盧交道，光擐甲執銳，身先士卒，鋒刃才交，桀衆大潰，斬首二千餘級。

s0122.quote: 直到宜陽，與周齊國公宇文憲、申國公拓跋顯敬相對十旬。

s0124.quote: 軍還，行次安鄴，憲等衆號五萬，仍躡軍後，光縱騎擊之，憲衆大潰，虜其開府宇文英、都督越勤世良、韓延等，又斬首三百餘級。

s0125.quote: 憲仍令桀及其大將軍中部公梁洛都與景興、士彥等步騎三萬於鹿盧交塞斷要路。

s0126.quote: 光與韓貴孫、呼延族、王顯等合擊，大破之，斬景興，獲馬千匹。

s0132.quote: 周柱國枹罕公普屯威、柱國韋孝寬等步騎萬餘，來逼平隴，與光戰於汾水之北，光大破之，俘斬千計。

s0136.quote: 是月，周遣其柱國紇幹廣略圍宜陽。

s0149.quote: 穆提婆求娶光庶女，不許。

s0141.quote: 帝聞光軍營已逼，心甚惡之，急令舍人追光入見，然後宣勞散兵。

s0150.quote: 帝賜提婆晉陽之田，光言於朝曰：「此田神武帝以來常種禾，飼馬數千匹，以擬寇難，今賜提婆，無乃闕軍務也？」

s0186.quote: 次須達，中護軍、開府儀同三司，先光卒。

s0193.quote: 羨，字豐樂，少有機警，尤善射藝，高祖見而稱之。

s0196.quote: 顯祖受禮，進號征西，別封顯親縣伯。

s0197.quote: 河清三年，轉使持節，都督幽、安、平、南、北營、東燕六州諸軍事，幽州刺史。

s0203.quote: 天統元年夏五月，突厥木汗遣使請朝獻，羨始以聞，自是朝貢歲時不絕，羨有力焉。

s0208.quote: 其年六月，丁父憂去官，與兄光並被起復任，還鎮燕薊。

s0212.quote: 時光子武都為兗州刺史。

s0216.quote: 三年七月，光誅，敕使中領軍賀拔伏恩等十餘人驛捕之。

s0217.quote: 遣領軍大將軍鮮于桃枝、洛州行臺僕射獨孤永業便發定州騎卒續進，仍以永業代羨。

s0222.quote: 及其五子世達、世遷、世辨、世酋、伏護，餘年十五已下者宥之。

s0225.quote: 行燕郡守馬嗣明，醫術之士，為羨所欽愛，乃竊問之，答曰：「須有禳厭。」

s0231.quote: 人問其故，金答云：「明月必背上著箭，豐樂隨處即下手，其數雖多，去兄遠矣。」

s0235.quote: 正光末，六鎮擾亂，隸大將軍尉賓北討。

s0238.quote: 與金擁衆南出，至黃瓜堆，為杜洛周所破，部落離散。

s0239.quote: 及歸尒朱榮，待之甚厚，以平襲父爵第一領民酋長。

s0243.quote: 周文帝遣其右將軍李小光據梁州，平以偏師討擒之。

s0246.quote: 侯景度江，詔平為大都督，率青州刺史敬顯俊、左衛將軍厙狄伏連等略定壽陽、宿預三十餘城。

s0251.quote: 廢帝即位，拜特進，食滄州樂陵郡幹。

s0001.quote: 斛律金 子光 羨

s0003.quote: 高祖倍侯利，以壯勇有名塞表，道武時率戶內附，賜爵孟都公。

s0005.quote: 父大那瓌，光祿大夫、第一領民酋長。
